notes.title: Regular Update
notes.content:
Mostly content work to prepare for early access (not visible in demo), but also includes the following, focusing on quality of life and incremental improvements for better user experience.



Patch notes:

Added a new visual cue for dangerous boss abilities

Added a new class of items, accessories, which provide various passive effects.  These can be acquired through completing a type of objective.

Autosave option now saves games whenever the game is paused if at least 10 seconds game time has passed, instead of only at the start of the stage.

Spells and items can now be moved by left clicking once and then left clicking again on the target location, rather than only by dragging (mouse only)

Single player games will now pause when Steam overlay is opened

Many bug fixes

Many adjustments to existing spells/aspects/upgrades

Performance improvements

Visual and audio improvements

notes.title: Regular Update
notes.content:
Changes
  

Fixed a regression that caused pixel alignment to be done incorrectly, resulting in more jerky motion than intended.  Additionally, added options for target frame rate and V-Sync in Settings menu.

Added a new camera style option that allows off center view.  The original camera style is available as an option in the Settings menu.

Changed the behaviors of several enemy types.  This improves the variety among enemies and helps make early stages more engaging.

Rebalancing pass on enemies and early spell progression. This improves the consistency of the early game (and generally makes the first few stages easier).

Player collision detecting has been adjusted to always be the minimum possible size regardless of character and facing.  This makes the collision detection consistent and mostly impacts dodging of enemy projectiles.

Second boss no longer summons additional waves of enemies while some still exist.  This reduces the possibility of the player being overwhelmed and always gives a chance to deal damage to the boss after dealing with the summons.

Added several new spell aspects, and upgrades to aspects that previously did not have any special upgrades.

Added several new talents.

Added one more unique item.

Spells now indicate if there are any available aspects that can be added to them.

Many improvements and fixes to various spells.

Reworked the Brutality spell aspect.

Reduced the damage dealt by apparitions created by delusion.

...and more content not visible in demo.

notes.title: New Feature + minor patch
notes.content:
New Feature - Codex


The Codex is a new feature accessible through the main menu that allows you to view most of the possible choices available in the game - only choices that you have previously picked in the past will be fully revealed, so that you can both track what you have tried out before and review the descriptions and stats of the various spells, aspects, talents, etc.


Patch notes
Added the Codex to the main menu, which allows you to view various categories of choices made and their descriptions

Spell are automatically bound to a free slot if possible when learning them

Many fixes to the set of new spells added last patch

Miscellaneous visual and audio improvements

New visuals for trees, as the previous visual was not clear what it was

Added interface option to set a fixed field of view 

Objectives now are more obvious and show their type when they first appear

Improved behavior of spell levelups when gaining multiple levels at once

Blood Magic spell aspect no longer has "Cannot be applied to remedy spells" and instead has "This spell cannot restore life in any way"

Slayer's Advance buff now only applies to non-translocation spells

You can now view the full details of spells granted by shrines by expanding the effect description in the character sheet

notes.title: Regular Update
notes.content:
Major changes


 Added support for Vulkan and D3D12 GPU drivers, and selection of GPU driver can be changed in the settings menu
 Added 8 new spells
 Many numerical adjustments to game mechanics
 Improvements to many visuals
 Moved "The Obscured" settings into the game start screen, so that it is easier to adjust while starting a game, particularly when playing multiplayer
 Adjusted game field of view, so that it is lower at the start and gradually increases to the previous value


Specific changes + bugfixes


 Improved how spell levelup options are merged when multiple levels are gained at once
 Adjust level requirements for early game spells
 Rejuvenation potion no longer grants increased resilience
 The delusion affliction now correctly spawns apparitions only near the player that has the affliction
 The modifier that multiplies the duration of shrines but limits you to one now only applies to spell shrines
 Experience objectives now grant more experience in later stages
 Boss kills are now counted for unlocks even if you are not the player actually killing the boss
 Vulnerability debuff no longer has the opposite of its intended effect
 Fixed a variety of client crashes and internal calculations

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
Improved monster death visuals
 Improved the accuracy of increased experience gain, so that now 100% increased experience gained will always result in twice as many levels gained (previously this was not quite correct, particularly when increased experience modifiers were applied after gaining some levels)

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
Features a new tutorial stage to help explain core game mechanics, and includes other minor improvements.


 Added a new tutorial stage to help explain the core game mechanics
 Unlockable achievements are now tracked to present a notification when new ones are unlocked
 Teleporting enemies can no longer teleport on top of a player
 Updates to various text descriptions
 Further improvements to the Estimated DPS calculations
 Numerical adjustments to some spell aspects
 Fixed an issue where some audio effects could be too loud when multiple sources occur simulataneously
 Fixed a bug that double counted players for progress on certain objectives

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content: Fixes some issues with estimated DPS calculations

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
Spell and character upgrade choices now show Estimated DPS changes as well as some other core values
 Starting a multiplayer game with only one player now requires confirmation
 Lobbies now update to reflect the actual max player count after the game has started
 Added more support for displaying keybinds in game
 Improved the game menus and interface at lower resolutions
 Linked upgrades that are exclusive with each other have visual indicator for this
 Players now have a visual effect applied and cannot take damage while being forcibly relocated
 Players taking damage now have an additional visual effect
 Added an audio and visual effect for gaining a level
 Gaining a level now provides 100% increased resilience and restores 50% of maximum hp over 1 second
 Reworked how spell levelups appear when a spell gains more than 1 level at once
 Quickness is back to 3% movement speed per point
 Added a new talent
 Fixed a bug where the world modifier that stops objectives from regressing did not apply to all types of objectives
 Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when starting a game before all players have chosen a character
 Fixed a bug where Energy Battery spell aspect could crash the game when loading a saved game

notes.title: Regular update
notes.content:
The main focus in this update is fleshing out the unlockable options within "The Obscured" page, accessible from the main menu.  These unlockables come in several flavors, allowing one to customize some facets of the game and character playstyle.  

For example, you can unlock the option to gain a crafting option to directly add the Dualcasting modifier to items, for those who prefer many spells or the item flexibility this allows.  Or you can change how objectives and you interact with them.

In addition, this update contains some improvements to gameplay elements, interface, and bug fixes.

Patch Notes

 Added many new unlockable options for "The Obscured"
 Improved some error handling and messaging when joining games fails
 Random events now show the results of their choices before you pick one
 The boss of The Bounds no longer has regenerating shield
 Quickness attribute now grants 4% (previously 3%) increased movement speed per point
 Stone Spikes spell now gains +1 burst at levels 10 and 20, instead of having those as level up options
 Firebolt and Lightningbolt spells now gain +1 fork at levels 10 and 20, instead of having those as level up options
 Fissure now gains +1 fork at levels 15 and 30, and +1 fork branch at levels 10 and 20, instead of having those as level up options
 Finesse now grants up to 4% increased resilience per point, with maximum effect when you would otherwise take 20% of your maxmimum life in damage
 The enemy modifier that allows firing projectiles now has larger projectiles based on the power of the projectiles
 The additional guardians in The Bounds before the stage boss deal 33% less damage, and any damage modifiers applied to them have 50% effect
 Winter Sigil Calamity upgrade has been reworked and now provides the following "Whenever you cast a water spell, Winter Sigil gains 25% increased area of effect for 8 seconds"
 The Blood Magic spell aspect has had the life cost penalty based on spellpower modifiers removed
 Various bug fixes for rare cases that could cause game crashes or desyncs

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.content:
Gameplay Changes

 Spell level ups will now occur when the player gains a level or transitions to a new stage.  This should help alleviate the disruptive nature of many spell levelups occurring close together.  Spell levels may still be too frequent in general, but that will have to be addressed separately.  Multiplayer games will still not pause on level up choices (unless a player pauses through other means).
 [spoiler] Accepting the Tree of Invocation's offer grants 0.5 (from 1) spellpower per level, as the original value far outweighed the downside. [/spoiler]

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.content:
Added a tutorial for using artifact fragments to craft items
 Added description for spellpower keyword, and added a line to spells that deal damage to state their scaling with spellpower

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.content: Mitigates an issue where the game could not function if the game user data folder is not accessible, and shows a more friendly error in such a case

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.content: Improved the tutorial messages on learning spells to indicate you can move other spells or swap spells if there are no free slots available

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.content: Internal bug fixes and optimizations (should not impact most users)
